name: Slides
description: Slide blocks to free the target

rules.title: How to Play
rules.rule1: Move blocks by sliding them horizontally or vertically
rules.rule2: Guide the red target block to the exit at the bottom
rules.rule3: Try to solve in minimum moves

hint: Tap a block then use arrows to move, or drag directly

difficultyDescriptions.medium: More pieces and a longer route
difficultyDescriptions.hard: Many moves, and several ways to get stuck

blocked: That block cannot move in this direction.
emptyBoard: Drag a block or tap a piece to select it
